React

Create user interfaces from components

React lets you build user interfaces out of individual pieces called components. Combine components to build screens, pages, and entire apps.

Add interactivity wherever you need it

React components receive data and display it. You can add interactivity by attaching event handlers to them.

Go full-stack with React

Use React with frameworks like Next.js to build full-stack apps.
